body: The bounded three-pass cycle is complete. A01–A07 and A09 are corrected; Focus membership p95 at 10,000 cards/one pin fell from 1,811.91 to 0.35 ms in the release application benchmark. Final review and new cold-index, undo, pending-write and pagination regressions found no additional reproducible application defect. Final gate: 238 Rust, 110 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; broad release HTTPS/planning checks and all 18 Chromium suites passed. WebKit session recovery/preferences also passed. The existing manual HTTPS application is verified; all 17 original resource versions, pins, preferences and certificate remain unchanged. One crash-test child exited unexpectedly in the first final gate; it did not recur in focused/full reruns, and failure diagnostics now retain child output. Its original cause remains unknown. Durable creation performance, physical-device/platform and full release acceptance remain open. Stop before changing authoritative storage or adding generic infrastructure. Evidence, measurements and resume/closure state: progress/2026-09-29-three-pass-plan.md. This report completes the sequence after ed7e93fd-3c3a-446d-a4f7-08ea343a9edd and 56cf690f-689f-4507-a343-2a22f689e924; card status and acceptance are unchanged.

metadata.summary: Three-pass remediation complete: final boundary audit and verification
